name: Fan-out query (scatter-gather)
description: A search must ask every shard: the search API sends each query to all 16 shards at once (fan-out 16) and merges the results when all are back. One shard read takes 8 ms on average, but a query waits for the slowest of 16, so the tail grows: asking one shard gives p50 51 ms and p99 82 ms; asking 16 gives p50 71 ms and p99 106 ms (including the users' 40 ms round trip). From 20 s, shard 5 is 10× slower. Every query touches it: while it is slow, p99 goes up to about 413 ms. Set this edge's "Quorum" to 15 (answer without one shard, like Google's good-enough responses): p99 goes down to about 99 ms, but a few results miss one shard.
